frozen_by: main agent (pre-registration discipline: no generation has run; FLOOD probe statistics known and disclosed)

scale.nominal_note: design DGN-13 工程规模 ≈100 航次；108 = 9 格 × 12 = 9 × (3 base draws × 2×2 family)

family_plan.direction_coverage: template segment sequence (outbound upstream / return downstream)

draw_index_ranges.rule: stratum i (0-based in strata list) uses base_draw_index in [i*1000, (i+1)*1000)

sampling_policy.sampler: mission_v3.env_realize('sample', formal_seed, base_draw_start, template, regime, stratum)

eligibility_semantics_frozen.authoritative_check: per-segment support bound (DGN-05 faithful reading): upstream segments u_adverse_abs_sup <= 1.8; return segments u_following_abs_sup <= 1.5 (realization.segments summaries)
eligibility_semantics_frozen.refinement_rationale: T-009 env-layer sup was a delegation-spec conservative pre-plan filter; DGN-05 bounds act on the per-segment along-track component. Refined at pre-registration BEFORE generation (no distribution peeking: T-009 FLOOD×WORK probe 58.1% under conservative sup is disclosed as the motivation, the refined semantics is the DGN-05-literal reading, NOT threshold tuning)
eligibility_semantics_frozen.token_structural_heldout: C1/C2/C3 EXCLUDE per frozen heldout_token_registry (IID side)

retry_policy.rule: FAILED_* slot: same slot, same config, same scientific seed retry (FR-537/R8); retry ledger rows recorded; REJECTED_* never occupy a slot (resampling per frozen policy)

rejection_threshold_frozen.definition: rejection_rate = (total_attempts - accepted) / total_attempts, per stratum and overall, at run end
rejection_threshold_frozen.verdict_rule: any stratum > 0.50 OR overall > 0.50 ⇒ MISSION_V3_PREQUALIFICATION FAIL (DGN-10 frozen candidate + R5 frozen-before-generation); controlled exposure by design (FR-539 拒绝率报告按 stratum 分组)
rejection_threshold_frozen.known_projection: T-009 FLOOD×WORK probe: 58.1% under conservative whole-voyage sup; under refined per-segment semantics projected materially lower (return following bound binds at ~25-30%) — projection is disclosed, NOT a threshold adjustment

guards.T429_result_metrics_zero: prequal manifest/artifacts SHALL NOT contain any SBD/BA/confidence/混淆结果度量（R3/R4）——only non-result readiness info
guards.no_post_hoc_augmentation: 禁看结果后增补航次；计划修订须显式登记 amendment（R4）
guards.two_run_determinism: 预资格链两跑 payload hash 一致（AC-438）
